# SB-1009 Safety bulletin: hot metal and scale ejection

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

## Hazard description
Hot metal and scale ejection from induction heaters can produce high-velocity projectiles and localized molten metal splash that create burn, impact, and eye hazards to operators and maintenance personnel. Observed incidents involve expulsion of scale and billet fragments during billet transfer and coil inspection activities on Hot Forge induction billet heater #3. The primary failure modes include loose scale detachment and sudden coil-to-billet contact events that eject material from the heater throat and surrounding work area.

Reference procedures for work control and protective measures are outlined in QS-PROC-01 and operational steps in SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-02. All personnel must assume the potential for ejection during inspection and transfer tasks and take prescribed controls.

## Affected equipment
- Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 — EQ-P1-L1-IH03 (located on Plant P1, line P1-L1)  
- Adjacent handling and transfer zones immediately upstream and downstream of EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Coil inspection activities for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) are set to a coil inspection interval of 290 hours. Adherence to this interval is mandatory for inspection scheduling and work planning.

## Required controls
- Apply engineering controls: ensure all fixed shielding and deflectors on EQ-P1-L1-IH03 are installed and secured per SOP-P1-L1-01 before any billet movement.  
- Administrative controls: schedule coil inspections in accordance with the 290 hours coil inspection interval for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and document completion in the line log; reference QS-PROC-01 for work authorization and isolation steps.  
- PPE: mandatory use of face shields, flame-resistant garments, and impact-rated eye protection during any activities within the exposure zone as defined in SOP-P1-L1-02.  
- Pre-task briefing: include ejection hazard review and barrier placement confirmation; postpone work until controls are verified.  
- Maintenance hold points: do not perform coil manipulation or billet transfer until a qualified lead confirms shielding and inspection completion per SOP-P1-L1-01.

## Effective date
Effective: Rev B
